Public.//: Abuse protection for the anonymous token-link surface (Architecture.md §12, ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md D65). Fixed window, partitioned by client IP, shared by every /api/v1/public route. These values match the compiled-in defaults and are stated here so the deployed policy is visible in a tracked file. NOTE: behind a reverse proxy without trusted ForwardedHeaders configuration, clients collapse into the proxy's address and share one bucket — see NEXT_STEPS.md.

TokenLink.//: How many days a customer's Angebot/Invoice token link stays valid (SRS FR-6.4 requires this to be configurable; 30 days is the example the SRS itself gives). Tracked, not secret — the token is the credential, this is only its lifetime. There is no compiled-in fallback: an absent or zero value fails startup naming this key.

Database.//: Verify = read-only readiness check at startup, never mutates schema (ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md D63). Migrate is a Development-only opt-in and is refused outright in Production. Stated explicitly here rather than relying on the built-in default, so the deployed behaviour is visible in a tracked file.
